title: Smt. Sushila Devi And Another v. State Of U.P. And 2 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.; Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Notice withdrawn; writ disposed, fresh order after hearing.
headnote: Recovery notice dated 23.8.2022 for electricity dues in a theft case was withdrawn by the department. The writ was disposed of with liberty to pass a fresh order after hearing, strictly in accordance with the procedure under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Smt. Sushila Devi and another petitioned the Allahabad High Court against a recovery notice dated 23 August 2022 raised by the electricity department for dues in a case of alleged theft of electricity. The State of Uttar Pradesh and two others were the respondents. Counsel for the electricity department informed the Court that the impugned notice had already been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be made after the petitioners were heard.

holding_units.topic: Theft-dues recovery notice withdrawn; fresh order under the Supply Code
holding_units.holding: Where the licensee withdraws a recovery notice for electricity dues in a theft case and states that a fresh order will follow an opportunity of hearing, the writ is disposed of with liberty to pass that order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: The order invokes the Supply Code procedure generally and does not number clause 7.7.4.

principle_tags.application: The 23.8.2022 theft-recovery notice stood withdrawn on the department's statement, and any fresh order was left to be passed only after hearing and strictly under the Supply Code procedure.

not_decided.point: Whether theft was made out and what dues, if any, are recoverable
not_decided.note: The impugned notice was withdrawn. Liability and quantum were left to a fresh order after hearing.
